scope: Author-selected routes for actual words, senses, constructions and communicative acts. Domain hints are optional leads, not global filters or guaranteed licences.

channels.use: Actual requests, choices, procedures, obligations and exceptions in public-facing instructions.
channels.queryAdvice: Combine the actual form/construction with a real action or object; open the operative instruction and necessary conditions.

channels.use: Actual change, retention, restoration, capacity and operating decisions in maintained documentation and first-hand issue discussion.
channels.queryAdvice: Use the target verb/construction plus a concrete task, object, error or decision. Technical definitions alone do not prove contextual use.

channels.use: Questions, objections, concessions and responses in original transcripts or public meeting records.
channels.queryAdvice: Search the target construction with the speech act; retain speaker, addressee and the response needed to understand it.

channels.use: Real events, decisions, constraints and consequences reported by verified editorial or first-party publishers.
channels.queryAdvice: Use the target expression and a concrete event/object; the existing publisher catalogue is a useful prior, not the boundary of search.

channels.use: Actual narrative, dialogue, historical and rare uses from traceable editions or archives.
channels.queryAdvice: Use exact forms and period-appropriate constructions; verify edition, context and applicable use conditions separately.

channels.use: Actual specialist use, derivations and constrained senses in original research and professional practice.
channels.queryAdvice: Use the true sense, term or collocation and domain; reject same-spelling neighbouring senses and generic word-definition pages.

channels.use: An independent outward search when fixed publishers or one discourse type do not supply the specific VIX sense.
channels.queryAdvice: Remove inherited site restrictions. Search actual forms/collocations with the communicative situation, then verify the found publisher and original. Search snippets are leads, not adopted context.

corpusLeadOnly.name: SKELL
corpusLeadOnly.use: Optional collocation and construction leads; locate and read a traceable original before adoption.
corpusLeadOnly.limit: Automatically selected corpus examples and similar words are not semantic approval, continuous neighbouring discourse, or a blanket republication licence.
